title: 2017 Bowman Draft Chrome Refractor Glenn Otto New York Yankees Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This Glenn Otto 2017 1st Bowman Draft Chrome Prospect card is a must-have for any baseball card collector. The card features a stunning Chrome Refractor design and showcases Otto in his New York Yankees uniform. It is a Sports Trading Card that is perfect for fans of the team and the sport alike. The card is manufactured by Bowman and is part of the 2017 Bowman Draft set. It is a great addition to any collection and is sure to impress.
